```json
{
  "issue": 6078,
  "status": "done",
  "branch": "claude/issue-6078-invoked-as-false-gate-claim",
  "pr": "https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/pull/6096",
  "premise_still_valid": true,
  "summary": "The card's premise holds: scripts/check-entry-guard.mjs does not exist here and the header asserted it as enforcement. Root cause measured beyond the card: #5984 ported invoked-as.mjs out of objectstack with its prose but without the gate or the sweep, so FOUR paths the header names resolve only in objectstack (check-entry-guard.mjs, pm/check-governed-merges.mjs, packages/cli/src/utils/invocation.ts, js-comment-mask.mjs) while all five exist there at 644ad5043. The correction therefore re-attributes four passages rather than deleting one sentence, and replaces the borrowed objectstack symlink example with the same measurement taken on a real objectui blocking gate. Two of the card's figures moved and are corrected: ONE module imports isEntrypoint (not two - the #5793 gate has not landed on main), and 29 hand-typed guards remain (not 27 - check-designer-field-key-parity.mjs landed since a1c41c516). One card claim was simply wrong: the guards are not all one shape, they are NINE textually distinct spellings, one of which (check-node-esm-load.mjs:847) is the percent-encoding failure the header itself warns about. Conversion and the gate port are out of scope per the PM ruling and are filed as #6092. One bounded in-place fix in the same file, named in the PR body: a self-test case reached for js-comment-mask.mjs (objectstack-only), so 'an unrelated existing file is not this module' had silently become a duplicate of the case below it; it now names a real neighbour with an existence assertion so it cannot degrade that way again.",
  "tests": "All runs on f726727cd (the final commit; clean tree, verified via git status --porcelain). Verdict lines quoted are the gates' own, not a bare $?.

MEASUREMENTS (each with the command that produced it, on origin/main @ 7c96c9420):
- Gate absent, with positive control: `ls scripts/check-entry-guard.mjs` -> 'No such file or directory'; `ls scripts/check-control-bytes.mjs` -> exists, 16244 bytes. `git ls-files | grep -c 'check-entry-guard'` -> 0; same for check-control-bytes -> 2. `git grep -n 'check-entry-guard'` -> exactly 1 hit, scripts/invoked-as.mjs:73 (the sentence itself); `git grep -l 'check-control-bytes' | wc -l` -> 16. The single hit is over ALL tracked files, so package.json and .github/workflows/ are covered - nothing runs such a gate.
- Provenance: the same five paths checked in /home/user/objectstack @ 644ad5043 - all five EXIST there, four are MISSING in objectui. objectstack's check-entry-guard.mjs is 787 lines and wired as `check:entry-guard` in package.json.
- Hand-typed guards: `git grep -l 'process\.argv\[1\]' -- 'scripts/'` -> 30 files; minus invoked-as.mjs itself -> 29 guards (28 .mjs + scripts/shadcn-sync.js). Card said 27; reconciled by `comm -13` against the same grep at a1c41c516 -> exactly one file added (check-designer-field-key-parity.mjs), none removed.
- No-realpath-leg shape: 28 of the 29. Only scripts/shadcn-sync.js:1048-1057 carries a realpath leg (`realpathSync(resolved) === __filename`).
- Distinct spellings: 9 across the 28 .mjs, via `git grep -n ... | cut -d: -f3- | sort | uniq -c` (12x, 5x, 3x, 2x, 2x, 1x, 1x, 1x, 1x). Card implied one shape.
- isEntrypoint importers: `git grep -l 'isEntrypoint' -- .` -> 2 files = invoked-as.mjs itself + ONE adopter, scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs:777. Card said two adopters.

SYMLINK INERTNESS - DEMONSTRATED, not inherited. One untracked guide file made deliberately wrong (removed by an EXIT/INT/TERM trap in the same command; `git status --porcelain` empty afterwards), then a real blocking gate run two ways against the identical defective tree:
  node scripts/check-skills-paths.mjs          -> exit=1, 696 bytes naming the dead path
  node <scratchpad>/link/check-skills-paths.mjs -> exit=0, 0 bytes
So a RED gate reports clean through a symlink. Separately measured, since the header asserts it: the ``import.meta.url === `file://${argv[1]}` `` spelling (check-node-esm-load.mjs:847) goes INERT in a directory named 'a#b c' with no symlink at all - file:///.../a%23b%20c/enc.mjs vs /.../a#b c/enc.mjs. Also checked before asserting and found NOT a bug: regenerate-known-schema-types.mjs:187 omits resolve() on argv[1], but node absolutizes argv[1] itself (measured by invoking a probe relatively).

REVERSE VERIFICATION of the new existence assertion. Predicted direction: red. Mutation proven on disk BEFORE reading any result, by anchored greps in both directions: injected "'js-comment-mask.mjs');" count=1, removed "'check-control-bytes.mjs');" count=0, `git diff --stat` = 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-). Run: `node scripts/invoked-as.mjs --self-test` -> exit=1, "1 of 12 case(s) failed", and the failing case is the new assertion only - the OLD case still passed with the dead path, which is exactly the vacuity being closed. Restored via `git checkout --` (the fix was committed first), restoration proven by the same greps inverted, re-run green 12/12, git status clean. No build is involved: this module is plain .mjs run directly, not resolved through any package dist, so there is no stale-artifact leg to rebuild.

GATES (exit captured before any pipe; verdict lines are the gates' own):
- node scripts/invoked-as.mjs --self-test -> exit 0, "invoked-as self-test: 12 cases pass" (was 11)
- npx vitest run scripts/__tests__ --maxWorkers=2, from the repo ROOT (never package-scoped) -> exit 0, "Test Files 65 passed (65)", "Tests 1789 passed (1789)"
- pnpm check:control-bytes -> exit 0, "check-control-bytes: OK (scanned 5036 tracked text file(s); skipped 85 binary)"
- pnpm check:skills-paths -> exit 0, "check-skills-paths: OK (93/94 stated path(s) resolve across 18 guide file(s); 1 baselined)" - also confirms the temp probe file is gone
- pnpm check:esm-specifiers -> exit 0, "Specifier leg: no un-ledgered package emits an extensionless relative specifier."
- pnpm check:node-esm-load -> exit 0
- node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs -> exit 0, "No source of a released package changed in this range, so no changeset is owed." Followed the gate's verdict: NO changeset added. objectui has no skip-changeset label mechanism and none was created or applied.
- grep -naP '[\x00-\x08\x0b\x0c\x0e-\x1f\x7f]' on the changed file -> clean

TWO DECLARED NARROWINGS (both measured, not skipped):
1. LINT. scripts/ is not a workspace package, so `pnpm lint` (turbo run lint, per-package fan-out) never reaches the changed file - measured, not assumed: pnpm-workspace.yaml globs packages/*, examples/*, apps/*, docs, and of the 47 workspace packages NONE has a directory containing scripts/. Linted directly instead: `npx eslint scripts/invoked-as.mjs --format json` -> exit 0, files linted = 1 (count read from the json), 0 errors, 0 warnings. Population read from eslint's own config: `--print-config` resolves a config for the file, so it is covered rather than merely unmatched. Invariance: eslint.config.js enables no type-aware linting (no projectService, no parserOptions.project, no recommendedTypeChecked), so a one-file diff with no config change cannot move any untouched file's verdict.
2. pnpm check:published-dist NOT RUN LOCALLY. Its criterion is the file list of every published package's tarball after a real build; it exceeded this container's ~10 minute foreground cap (SIGTERM, exit 143). Sound to narrow for the same measured reason as lint: scripts/ is inside no workspace package, so this diff cannot appear in any package's dist/ or change any tarball's file list. CI runs it regardless.

LIMIT OF THIS VERIFICATION, stated because it is the card's own point: this change is prose. No gate catches a false comment, and none will keep the corrected one true - the original header was false and every gate in this repository stayed green. The durable remedy is the gate tracked in #6092.",
  "open_questions": [],
  "out_of_scope_findings": [
    "filed as #6092: port objectstack's check-entry-guard.mjs (787 lines, two rules, wired as check:entry-guard there) and convert the 29 hand-typed entry guards to isEntrypoint - the conversion half the PM ruled out of scope for this PR, filed unassigned with all measured numbers, the nine-spelling breakdown, and the symlink and percent-encoding demonstrations",
    "recorded inside #6092 rather than filed separately, since they are the same worklist: (a) check-node-esm-load.mjs:847 still carries the exact percent-encoding spelling invoked-as.mjs's header warns about, measured inert in a directory named 'a#b c' with no symlink involved; (b) the worklist GROWS while the card sits open - one guard was added between a1c41c516 and 7c96c9420, which is the argument for porting the gate before doing the sweep; (c) scripts/shadcn-sync.js already hand-types the correct two-leg shape, so converting it is a simplification rather than a fix"
  ]
}
```
